description:
APPLICATION
FOR VARIATION OF  CONDITION 2 (APPROVED PLANS) ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING
APPLICATION  25/P0703  RELATING TO THE   APPLICATION FOR
THE ERECTION OF A FIRST FLOOR SIDE EXTENSION. CHANGES RELATE TO THE FIRST FLOOR
BEING BUILT OF THE GROUND FLOOR WALLS BUT STILL USING THE MATERIALS AS SHOWN IN
THE APPROVAL
decision_conditions:
Matching Materials - The facing materials used in the development hereby permitted shall match those of the existing building in materials, style, colour, texture and, in the case of brickwork, bonding, coursing and pointing.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

Obscured Glazing (Fixed Shut) - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the windows in the first floor side facing window in the south elevation shall be glazed with obscure glass and fixed shut and shall permanently maintained as such thereafter.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

The development hereby approved shall implement the fire safety measures as submitted with the proposal titled: Fire Safety Strategy. These measures shall thereafter be retained in perpetuity Reason: To ensure that the development complies with policy D12 of the London Plan 2021
